## Telegram Webhook Setup Instructions

### 1. Create a Telegram Bot
- Message @BotFather on Telegram
- Run `/newbot` and follow prompts
- Save the bot token

### 2. Configure Webhook (replace with your n8n URL):
```
https://api.telegram.org/bot<YOUR_BOT_TOKEN>/setWebhook?url=https://your-n8n-domain.com/webhook/dubai-re-telegram
```

### 3. Add credentials in n8n:
- Go to Settings > Credentials
- Add 'Telegram API' credential with your bot token
- Replace TELEGRAM_BOT_CREDENTIAL_ID in this workflow

### 4. OpenAI Setup (optional):
- Add OpenAI API credential for the AI agent
- Replace OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_ID in this workflow

### 5. Property API:
- Replace Search Properties HTTP node URL with your actual Dubai property API
- Or remove it and use the agent with built-in knowledge only
